arguments.content:
# Cold showers and recovery: two takes

**For:** meta-analysis shows a real (moderate) drop in soreness 24-48h after hard sessions.

**Against:** a trial found routine cold immersion blunts strength/hypertrophy adaptations over time.

**Read:**
- https://sportsmed-review.org/cold-water-immersion-meta
- https://recovery-science.net/cwi-inflammation-trial

Short version: nice for soreness, counterproductive if gains are the goal.
